baseline_tension: Nothing I found cuts against the baseline: the stock had already given back 5.9% in five sessions and 9.1% in twenty, and by the print-day snapshot it was trading 436.95 mid-session against a 456.01 prior close, so the margin fear the corpus is full of was visibly being priced in real time.
corpus_limits: No option chain, hence no implied move and no skew from the baseline; the corpus does contain a snippet-only headline ('Dell shares may move 11% on Sept 1 earnings release', ng.investing.com 93CH-2674010) that failed to fetch, and an optionslam straddle-history page I did not lean on because it is a live page that could have been updated after the print — either would suggest the market priced a wider move than the 8.88% historical median, but I could not verify a number.
